prompt_text: A decrepit, clapped-out spaceship drifting through the void, unmistakably the spacefaring equivalent of a rusted-out old Nissan Micra dredged from a scrapheap. Mismatched hull panels held together with duct tape, rivets and hope; patches of orange rust creeping across dented plating; one running light flickering, another missing entirely. A cracked cockpit windscreen, a wing-mirror bolted on at a jaunty angle, and a wheezing exhaust venting a thin trail of vapour. Faded, peeling paint with the ghost of a proud name barely legible on the side. Cinematic lighting, cold starlight, photorealistic, highly detailed, dramatic but deeply unglamorous. The pride of a captain who really ought to know better.
